name: Sunpol Solar
old_description: This page was written and reviewed by the SunPol Solar team in Avon, Connecticut. We are an independent solar company and solar installer founded in 2023, specializing in residential solar panel installations across Connecticut and Massachusetts. Our team holds Connecticut Home Improvement Contractor License HIC-0698394 and maintains BBB accreditation.
about:
SunPol Solar is an independent residential solar installer founded in 2024 and headquartered in Newington, Connecticut. The company was started on the premise that lowering a family's energy costs returns both money and time to the household, allowing them to focus on priorities beyond the monthly electric bill. No founders are named in public materials.

SunPol designs, permits, and installs rooftop solar arrays and Tesla Powerwall 3 battery storage for homeowners across all 169 Connecticut towns and throughout Massachusetts. The company offers three financing paths: a flagship Prepaid Solar Program that bundles equipment, installation, monitoring, and maintenance into a single upfront payment with zero monthly charges for 25 years; a power purchase agreement with a fixed per-kWh rate and no upfront cost; and a traditional cash purchase. To date, the team has completed over 100 installations ranging from roughly 10 kW to 20 kW, using premium Tier 1 panels and microinverters backed by 25-year warranties.

The customer base is exclusively residential, with recent projects documented in Newington, Bristol, Farmington, Wolcott, Newtown, and Southington. Battery backup is frequently sized for critical loads such as refrigeration, lighting, Wi-Fi, and medical equipment including CPAP machines, oxygen concentrators, and insulin pumps.

SunPol differentiates itself by retaining ownership of prepaid-lease systems for the full 25-year term, providing a single point of accountability for service and repairs. The prepaid pricing is marketed at roughly 30 percent below a comparable cash purchase, and the company emphasizes local presence—permits, inspections, and interconnection are handled in-house by a Connecticut-based team.
